Release notes again. Commits since 2.4:
- iPad split view
- fix widget not updating on iOS 26
- migrate to Swift 6
Write the What's New (under 500 chars, friendly, skip internal stuff) and translate to German, French, Spanish, Japanese, Romanian. I do this every release and it's tedious, and I always forget which languages the app supports.
What's New in 2.5: Pocket Plant Log now supports iPad split view, and widgets update reliably again. (Translations follow…)

Another batch of reviews (Pocket Plant Log and Tide Timer). Group them: bug / feature request / praise, tell me which bugs show up more than once, and draft replies I can paste back into App Store Connect.

- "Tide times wrong for my harbor" (Tide Timer, 2 stars)
- "Please add iCloud sync" (Pocket Plant Log, 3 stars)
- "Widget blank on lock screen" (Pocket Plant Log, 2 stars)
- "iCloud sync please!!" (Pocket Plant Log, 4 stars)
- "Perfect little app" (Tide Timer, 5 stars)
Bugs: tide times (Tide Timer), lock-screen widget (Pocket Plant Log). Feature requests: iCloud sync appears twice. Praise: 1. Draft replies: …

Help me write a polite email to my client Dana Whitfield (dana.whitfield@example.com, +1 555 0142) explaining that the booking app delivery moves by two weeks because of the new privacy manifest requirements.
Subject: Updated delivery date for the booking app…

2.6 is ready. Commits:
- Live Activity for watering
- fix photo delete crash
- update fastlane
You know the drill: What's New under 500 chars + de/fr/es/ja/ro. Then I'll paste each one into App Store Connect by hand, five times.
What's New in 2.6: Follow watering with a Live Activity, and deleting photos no longer crashes. (Translations follow…)

A Japanese user emailed that the new Live Activity shows English text. Again I shipped with missing translations in Localizable.xcstrings. I really should build something that checks the string catalog for untranslated keys before I archive. How do I find all keys missing a ja translation?
String catalogs are JSON. You can list keys where the ja localization is missing or its state is not 'translated'…
